pack_unpack_any_message: pack a protobuf message into an Any type and unpack it back to the original message
convert_timestamp_to_json: convert a protobuf Timestamp to an RFC 3339 JSON string and parse a JSON string back to Timestamp
convert_duration_to_json: convert a protobuf Duration to a JSON string and parse a JSON duration string back to Duration
merge_field_mask_messages: merge fields specified in a FieldMask from a source message into a destination message
build_struct_listvalue: build a protobuf Struct with nested fields and ListValue using dict-like and list-like operations
